page.content:
Titan who stole fire for mortals and was chained for it.

How Prometheus connects

  • Character: Zeus — Prometheus stole fire and was punished by Zeus.
  • Faction: Titans — Prometheus is a Titan who sided with mortals against Zeus.
  • Character: Heracles — Heracles later frees Prometheus from the rock.

What is Prometheus?

Prometheus tricked Zeus at the sacrifice, brought fire to humankind, and was bound on the rock until Heracles freed him. He stands with the Titans against Olympian order.

Key threads lead to Zeus, Titans and Heracles.
